title: How a chalk talk gets built
subtitle: from a scene file to a page you can step through

steps.title: It starts as a story
steps.say: Claude never draws. It writes a short **scene file**: what to show, what moves, what to say.

steps.title: One script builds it
steps.say: `build.sh` checks the JSON and refuses a stray `</script`, the one string that would break the page.

steps.title: Real code comes along
steps.say: Nodes can point at real lines. The embedder copies them in, so a click on a block shows its code.

steps.title: Into the engine
steps.say: The scene drops into the engine's `__SCENE__` slot. Layout, routing and 3D drawing all happen in the browser.

steps.title: A page you can send
steps.say: Out comes **one HTML file**. Click any block with a code badge, or press `C`, to see the code behind it.

steps.title: The whole trip
steps.say: Story, build, embed, page. Every block with a `</>` badge opens the code it stands for.
